findings.summary: The implementation intersects task IDs touched anywhere under .agentplane/tasks/<id>/ with DONE release registry candidates, accepts only a unique exact match, preserves unique version fallback, and refuses ambiguous attribution.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

hidden_assumptions: A future release commit that carries no task-scoped artifact relies on the unique version-registry fallback, as before.
